name: Friday
description: A private voice and text assistant for one Linux workstation: microphone input, transcription, Qwen inference, durable memory, and speech output all run locally. No hosted inference or telemetry is required for the core assistant.
audience: Linux power users with an NVIDIA GPU who want a private assistant that can actually act on the desktop — with receipts.
positioning: Local conversation, durable memory, and approved computer actions.

features.title: Talk, don't type
features.description: Voice turns are heard, answered, and spoken — Parakeet ASR on CPU, Piper or OmniVoice for speech, Qwen doing the thinking, all on your machine.

features.title: Actions with receipts
features.description: Policy checks, exact approvals, and post-action receipts sit between model output and state-changing work. The model can propose; Friday reports done only after the executor records evidence.

features.title: Durable local memory
features.description: Transcripts, tasks, corrections, preferences, reminders, and receipts persist in SQLite — Friday recalls last week's decisions from your local graph.

features.title: Bounded tools
features.description: File, process, browser, web, and desktop tools with granted paths and network access only for the URLs you give.
